rows.title: cd-guard.sh
rows.note: Exists to keep a cd from moving the prompt-embedded cwd (claude-setup@2ea2cb72, rewrite since 4a65439d). Price 0.175% of spend (Injected text 1.64M, Blocked calls 324k a week) plus Speed 15.75 min/day. Effect: the rewrite note tells the model its cd did not stick (kept); the deny carries the fix. Cut: note 'cd-guard ran this in a subshell: the working directory did not change.' -> 'cd-guard: ran in a subshell, cwd unchanged.', deny reason ~40% shorter, no fork on cd-free calls; replay 7000 real calls identical decisions (claude-setup@c5a2a69). Next lever: no-op cds into the cwd (26% of cd calls), owner's call.
